from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import WebhookDeliveryLog
from .services import dispatch_outbound_payload

class ReplayFailedWebhookView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, delivery_id):
        delivery = get_object_or_404(
            WebhookDeliveryLog,
            id=delivery_id,
            endpoint__merchant=request.user.merchant
        )

        retry_response = dispatch_outbound_payload(
            target_url=delivery.endpoint.target_url,
            payload=delivery.payload,
            secret=delivery.endpoint.secret
        )
        delivery.retry_count += 1
        delivery.save(update_fields=['retry_count'])
        return Response({'replayed': True, 'http_status': retry_response.status_code})
